# Presidio Production to Participate in Stephens Annual Investment Conference


November 04, 2026 8:30am EST


*Fireside Chat Scheduled for November 18 at 10:30 a.m. ET; Management to Host One-on-One Investor Meetings*


FORT WORTH, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Presidio Production Company](https://bypresidio.com/) (“Presidio” or the “Company”) (NYSE: FTW), a technology driven operator of mature oil and gas wells across the central U.S., today announced that management will participate in a fireside chat and hold one-on-one meetings with institutional investors at the Stephens Annual Investment Conference, taking place November 17–19, 2026, in Nashville, Tennessee.


Will Ulrich, Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer, and Chris Hammack, Director and Co-Chief Executive Officer, will represent Presidio at the conference. During the fireside chat and investor meetings, management will discuss Presidio’s acquisition strategy, its differentiated operating model focused on optimizing existing production, and recent financial and operational developments.


**Stephens Annual Investment Conference**
Date: November 17 – 19, 2026
Fireside Chat: Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 10:30 AM ET / 9:30 AM CT
Location: Nashville, TN
Format: Fireside chat and 1x1 meetings
Attendees: Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer Will Ulrich, Director and Co-Chief Executive Officer Chris Hammack


For more information on the Stephens Annual Investment Conference, or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with Presidio management, please contact your Stephens representative or you may also email your request toFTW@mzgroup.us or call Chris Tyson at (949) 491-8235.


**About Presidio Production Company**


Headquartered in Fort Worth, TX, Presidio Production Company (NYSE: FTW) is a yield-focused, differentiated oil and gas operator in the United States focused on the acquisition and optimization of producing oil and natural gas wells, without drilling. Presidio applies engineering expertise and AI-driven analytics to enhance performance and extend asset life. The Company’s Class A common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “FTW”. To learn more, visit[https://bypresidio.com/](https://bypresidio.com/) .
